application_fee.details: Under Advt. 33, candidates must pay a non-refundable application processing fee of Rs. 590/ -. Candidates belonging to SC, ST and PwBD categories, as well as all internal candidates, are exempted from paying this fee. | The application fee for the Engineering Assistant posts under Advt. 34 is not specified in this notification.

age_limit.details: Age relaxation is applicable to SC/ ST/ OBC/ PwBD/ Ex-servicemen categories and departmental candidates as per Government of India norms. The crucial date for determining age is the closing date for receipt of applications. There is no age bar for departmental (currently working at IIM Mumbai) candidates under Advt. 33.

qualification.details: For all three Engineering Assistant posts, candidates need a Bachelor's degree in the relevant engineering discipline (Civil, Electrical or MEP) with minimum 55% marks and at least 2 years of post-qualification on-site experience, OR a 3-year Diploma in the relevant discipline with minimum 60% marks and at least 4 years of post-qualification on-site experience. Candidates with a relevant Master's degree can count the normal duration of the Master's programme towards the required experience.

salary_details.deputy general manager (academics): Pay Level 12: Rs. 78,800 - 2,09,200 (Gross Pay includes Basic Pay + Dearness Allowance + House Rent Allowance + Transport Allowance + Dearness Allowance on Transport Allowance)
salary_details.manager (academics/ general admin): Pay Level 10: Rs. 56,100 - 1,77,500 (same allowance structure as above)
salary_details.engineering assistant (civil/ electrical: Rs. 45,000/ - per month + OCA Rs. 4,500/ - per month + Mobile Reimbursement Rs. 500/ - per month
salary_details.details: Additional benefits for Advt. 33 posts may include campus/ leased accommodation (with electricity and water charges payable by the candidate; HRA is not admissible if accommodation is provided), medical facilities as per Institute rules, and Children Education Allowance for up to two children as per Central Government norms.

how_to_apply: Visit the official IIM Mumbai careers portal at https:/ / iimmumbai.ac.in/ careers.
Select the relevant advertisement (Admn/ Rectt/ 2026/ 33 or Admn/ Rectt/ 2026/ 34) and the post you wish to apply for. Candidates may apply for one post only under Advt. 33.
Fill in the online application form, mandatorily providing a valid and active email ID, since all official communication will be sent only via email.
Upload a recent photograph (not older than six months) and scanned copies of certificates supporting qualification, experience, date of birth, category, and disability (if applicable).
Pay the applicable non-refundable application fee online, where applicable (Rs. 590/ - for Advt. 33 posts, with exemptions for SC/ ST/ PwBD and internal candidates).
Submit the application before the last date: 29 September 2026 (05:00 PM).

Government/ Semi-Government/ PSU employees must apply through proper channel and submit a No Objection Certificate from their current employer. Incomplete applications without proper supporting documents will be summarily rejected.

Candidates with qualifications such as Postgraduation, Graduation, MBA, B.E., B.Tech, Diploma and other relevant qualifications can also explore more Management Government Jobs, Engineering Jobs and Government Jobs available across India.

Candidates looking for opportunities in Maharashtra can also explore the latest Maharashtra Government Jobs and Mumbai Government Jobs. content_sections.heading: IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: For Advt. 33 posts, the selection process involves scrutiny/ screening of applications by a Screening Committee, followed by a written test and/ or skill test and/ or interview, or any other assessment mode the Institute deems appropriate, for shortlisted candidates only. For Advt. 34 (Engineering Assistant) posts, the selection process may include one or more stages such as a written test, skill/ competency test, and/ or personal interview, or any other mode of assessment as decided by the Competent Authority. In both notifications, merely meeting the minimum eligibility criteria does not guarantee a call for the next stage, and the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called forward based on higher qualifications and/ or experience.

faq.question: Q1. What is IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It refers to two recruitment notifications issued by IIM Mumbai on 09 September 2026 (Advt. 33 and Advt. 34) inviting online applications for various non-teaching and Engineering Assistant posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies under Advt. 33 across six posts, and 8 vacancies under Advt. 34 across three Engineering Assistant posts, making 21 vacancies in total.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for both notifications is 29 September 2026 (05:00 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification requirements vary by post, ranging from graduation to a master's degree, along with specified years of relevant administrative or engineering experience. Full post-wise qualification details are given in the qualification section above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit ranges from "preferably below 30 years" for Junior Assistant posts up to 45 years for Manager-level posts, with age relaxation available for reserved categories as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: For Advt. 33 posts, the application fee is Rs. 590/-, with exemptions for SC, ST, PwBD and internal candidates. The application fee for Advt. 34 Engineering Assistant posts is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official careers portal at https://iimmumbai.ac.in/careers before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for IIM Mumbai Recruitment 2026 posts?
faq.answer: Salary ranges from Pay Level 04 to Pay Level 12 as per 7th CPC for Advt. 33 posts, and Rs. 45,000/- per month plus allowances for Engineering Assistant posts under Advt. 34. Full details are given in the salary section above.
